items.title: Canada squeaks by Latvia in overtime at men's world junior hockey championship

items.title: World Cup tickets in Toronto are expensive to begin with. Ontario's resale regulations don't help
items.description: With tickets to next year's six World Cup games in Toronto selling out as quickly as they're released, the only option for most soccer fans is the resale market. But a 2019 decision by the Ontario government has allowed tickets to those matches, and other major events, to go sky high.

items.title: Political control over ancient sites sparks alarm in Ontario

items.title: Annette Dionne, last of the famed Canadian quintuplets, dies at 91
